CAS — 132203-70-4. ATC — C08CA14. ATC Vet — QC08CA14. Profile Cilnidipine is a dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker (p.1154) given orally in the management of hypertension (p.1171). The usual dose is 5 to 10 mg once daily, increased to 20 mg once daily if necessary. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Jpn: Atelec; Cinalong; Port.: Tenvasc. In Jpn and US. USP 31 (Cilostazol). White to off-white crystals. Practically insoluble in water; slightly soluble in alcohol and in methyl alco- hol; freely soluble in chloroform.
